title: Resource Utilization, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Resource Utilization workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 1 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Resource Utilization Consultant Roster list.
steps.expected: 10 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (ConsultantRosterId CON-401), with Level Senior.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Resource Utilization Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 5 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 1 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Operations Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Where are we under target today, and which parts of the workforce are sitting available?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Firm utilization; Bench; Utilization by Level. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Resource Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What capacity is coming free, and how does it line up with the opportunities expected over the next quarter?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Upcoming Project Endings; Pipeline Demand; Total roles in pipeline. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Finance Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show me who is on the bench, the skills we are carrying, and the cost exposure we need to address.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: David Okafor; Robert Garcia; Skill Inventory on Bench. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Resource Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which available consultants fit the strongest pipeline needs, and who still needs another path?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Bench-to-Pipeline Matches; Unmatched Bench Resources; Robert Garcia. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Operations Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Give me an upskilling and internal-innovation plan for the people we cannot place directly, including the business case.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: D365 integration accelerator; Synthetic payback scenario; Innovation and Capability-Building Options. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Resource Utilization: 1 read-only tabs from the same lists. 10 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (ConsultantRosterId CON-401), with Level Senior.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Resource Utilization Consultant Roster from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload consultant-roster.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ConsultantRosterId, Level, CompleteSkills, Status, CurrentProject, ProjectEnd to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep RateHR, Utilization as Number. Name the list Resource Utilization Consultant Roster. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 10 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (ConsultantRosterId CON-401), with Level Senior.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Resource Util Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Resource Utilization Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the one list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_resource-pipeline-and-workforce-rules.md, aibast_resource-synthetic-roster.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the consultant roster tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Resource Utilization Consultant Roster; name the tool Get consultant roster records.
steps.expected: Get consultant roster records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 5 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 5 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 5 skills, the rules knowledge and 1 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 5 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 1 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: resource-utilization-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 1 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Resource Utilization Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Resource Utilization Consultant Roster" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 1 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Resource Utilization Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Resource Utilization Consultant Roster tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 10 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (ConsultantRosterId CON-401), with Level Senior.
